title: Abazinikeleyo Abathembisiweyo
intro: Umprofeti ohlonitshwayo wahamba phakathi kwabantu, ebabizela enyanisweni. Abaninzi bajika ngenkani, kodwa iqela elincinci elizinikeleyo laphendula ubizo laza lazibophelela ngentliziyo yonke. Bavavanywa ngamathandabuzo baza baba nesibindi sokufuna inkxaso yasezulwini. Ukuzinikela kwabo okungagungqiyo kwaba sisifundo sokholo esingapheliyo. Babengoobani?
clues: Sasiliqela elincinci elaphakama ukuze lixhase umsebenzi kaThixo ngexesha lokungakholelwa okwandileyo.
Umprofeti ohloniphekileyo weza waza wasibiza ukuba sime njengabahlobo bethu kwinjongo ka-Allah.
Xa umprofeti wabuza ukuba ngoobani ababeza kuxhasa uThixo, saphendula ngaphandle kokuthandabuza.
Sazama ukucela isidlo esingummangaliso esithunyelwe ezulwini ukuze siqinise iintliziyo zethu.
Umprofeti wethu wasikhumbuza ukuba simhlonele u-Allah ukuba singamakholwa okwenene, kodwa isicelo sethu sokuthobeka sahlonitshwa.
Sasingabantu abazinikeleyo abathembise ukholo olungagungqiyo kunye no-Isa, unyana kaMaryam.

trial.answer: Ukucelwa ukuba sibe ngabaxhasi benjongo ka-Allah

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
